body:
## Council question

With five players including Bene Tleilax, the contributions produce four cards rather than five. Is that player count supported, and if so how is the fifth card supplied? Give one rule for supported player counts.

## Source evidence

Quickstart v0.8 takes one card from each other faction's unchosen traitors, substituting an undealt card for Harkonnen. The current Bene Tleilax sheet requires five cards, one chosen traitor and four Face Dancers. These match in a six-player game.

## Draft treatment

The supported surrounding rules are drafted. This detail is marked as awaiting council verification; no answer has been assumed.

## Sources

Quickstart v0.8, Step-by-Step Setup; current Bene Tleilax Infiltration sheet.

Part of #1831. Norbert will review these questions together after the full drafting pass. An answer of "I think so, but I need to verify" remains provisional.
title: Dreamrules ruling: How are Bene Tleilax starting cards dealt outside six-player games?
